## Description
Please include a summary of the change, motivation, and which issue is fixed or addressed.

## Type of Change
- [ ] New guideline or reference material
- [ ] Bug fix in existing instructions or code snippets
- [ ] New checklist or example implementation
- [ ] Integration guide improvement
- [ ] Script / CI automation enhancement

## Apple Authority Level
Which authority level governs this change?
- [ ] Level 1: Official Apple Requirement
- [ ] Level 2: Official Apple Recommendation (HIG)
- [ ] Level 3: Platform Convention
- [ ] Level 4: Community Best Practice
- [ ] Level 5: Design Engineering Recommendation (Kowalski Motion / Polish)

## Checklist
- [ ] My code and markdown follow the project style guidelines.
- [ ] I have cited all official documentation sources.
- [ ] I have run `./scripts/validate-skill.sh` locally and all checks passed.
- [ ] I have verified that all internal markdown links resolve correctly.
- [ ] Any new SwiftUI code includes both correct patterns and anti-patterns where appropriate.
